Lucide 0.469.0 (ISC, see LICENSE), icon shapes from the npm package lucide-static@0.469.0 (icons/*.svg).
icons.svg holds the icons the interface uses as <symbol> elements; the shapes are unchanged, the
stroke settings live in CSS (.icon in theme.css). The other files are single icons for CSS masks
and backgrounds. chevron-down-muted.svg is chevron-down with the stroke colour set to #65768d, for a CSS background.
Rebuilt by tools/build_icons.py, which keeps only the icons the page, scripts and styles name.
Icons (27): arrow-left, arrow-right, arrow-up-right, book-open, check, chevron-down, chevron-right, circle-alert, circle-check, circle-help, clipboard-check, file-text, history, inbox, link, loader-circle, notebook-pen, panel-left-close, panel-left-open, pencil-line, plus, settings, sparkles, table-of-contents, upload, users, x
